body.name: Restriction-normal and unrestricted-gradient representers
body.construction: For every regular observed-data score \(s\), \(E_O[R_{b,x}s]=\left.\partial_{\varepsilon}r_{b,x}(P_{O,\varepsilon})\right|_{\varepsilon=0}\) componentwise and \(E_O[g_{b,x}s]=\left.\partial_{\varepsilon}\theta_{b,x}(P_{O,\varepsilon})\right|_{\varepsilon=0}\), where \(\theta_b=\sum_x\theta_{b,x}\) and each representer is mean zero and supported on \(X=x\). In particular, \(R_{\mathrm{PT},x}\) represents the derivative of \(-A_{\mathrm{PT}}D(x)\), has \(J\) displayed coordinates and rank \(J-1\), and contains no derivative of the unobserved \(\delta_1^0(x)\).
